audit.why: Difficulty is graded EVEN at 5.5/10 with a 55.56% win rate over 783 games. Mel has no dash and Aurora holds W (22s) as an exit plus E (15s at rank 1) as a slow, so lane difficulty tracks the two ranged skillshots (Radiant Volley 950 range, Solar Snare 1000 range) against Aurora's 900-range Q. Side-lane and teamfight difficulty rise because Golden Eclipse has 25000 range and ignores distance.

Spikes verified against both kits: Aurora's level 3 completes Q/W/E; level 6 adds the R zone on a 140s clock at rank 1; Mel's level 6 Golden Eclipse is 120s at rank 1 and only pays out on pre-existing Overwhelm stacks. Rebuttal scales 38s to 26s, so Mel's own lane spike is really her W ranks, not her item timings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Searing Brilliance (P) both loads Mel's next auto with bonus projectiles after any cast and executes on stacked Overwhelm damage. The auto-reset wind-up is the burst tell, and the execute is an HP threshold, not a health-bar read.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: any ability grants three bonus projectiles (max nine) on the next attack, and Overwhelm stacks are consumed to execute. Both are listed in missingInteractions for this matchup. Rebuttal reflecting Aurora's projectile Q and blanking damage is already stated and is correct.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now names the post-cast auto tell; breakdown.late now names the execute threshold alongside the global R.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers: Rebuttal 38s/26s, Solar Snare 11s, Aurora W 22s, R 140s. All match the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields refer to Mel with male pronouns: phases[0].why ("his last-hits"), phases[5].why ("his cooldown gaps"), dosFull[1].d ("he answered"), dontsFull[1].t ("his optimal range").
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists mel as female; lintFindings flags all four deterministically.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with she/her; phases[5].why also re-grounded onto Rebuttal's 26s gap instead of a generic 'cooldown gaps'.

audit.why: Nothing in the brief indicates a 26.15 change to either kit; cooldown values on the page match the kit files as shipped.

notes: Level chart is all-Aurora across seven rows in both layers and agrees with the packet chart and the 55.56% win rate, so no chart rows were moved. breakdown.difficulty ('Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Mel carry threat 6/10.') is structurally templated but is a pure ratings restatement with nothing enemy-specific to ground, so it was left alone. breakdown.carry, ahead and breakdown.feeding all already reference Mel-specific mechanics (no dash, Rebuttal 26s, Overwhelm) and were judged non-templated.
